meta.title: Vim Navigation
meta.description: Browse the Harness in Vim style: j/k scroll, kk at the top loads earlier history, h/l switch panel focus, i enters the composer, dd clears the draft, jk exits edit mode, Ctrl+J/K jump to the next/previous message, gg/G jump to the top/bottom, Ctrl+F searches sessions, Space/Enter select a workspace row while preserving the mode you were in, and Ctrl+W no longer closes the window.
